data.description:
## Context / Problem
88 held-out modules (17,106 LOC) have no base twin. 10 of them are handled elsewhere: the 8 `tests/scripts/*_seam_clean_heldout.py` modules and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py` in the test-suite epic's seam story (E10a-S1), and `tests/unit/test_config_gate_wiring_heldout.py`, deleted in its single-owner story (E10a-S3). The remaining 78 (unit 55, interfaces 18, scripts 4, integration 1) keep a `_heldout` suffix that no longer distinguishes anything once S2, S3 and S4 have merged every pair. Three of the 78 are cross-tier twins whose base lives in another directory and would collide on basename under pytest's prepend import mode (13 `__init__.py` files under `tests/`; no `--import-mode` in `pyproject.toml:8`), so they take a disambiguating suffix instead. The rename rules and the three cross-tier renames are itemised in this ticket's first comment. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
- `git mv` each of the 75 ordinary unpaired modules from `test_<name>_heldout.py` to `test_<name>.py`, in place, with no content change.
- The three cross-tier files take disambiguating suffixes: `tests/interfaces/store/test_repair_pause_ownership_heldout.py` (base `tests/scripts/graph/test_repair_pause_ownership.py`) → `test_repair_pause_ownership_store.py`; `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_baseline_normalization_heldout.py` (base under `tests/integration/`) → `test_baseline_normalization_diffing.py`; `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_identity_264f_heldout.py` (base `tests/unit/test_identity_264f.py`) → `test_identity_264f_reconciler.py`. Do not merge across tiers.
- `tests/interfaces/facades/test_reconciler_last_pass_heldout.py` carries the tests E10a-S1 moved into it along with the rename.
- Paths under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` are stated at the current name; the reconciler epic (friended-brainsick-degus) rename carries them.
- After this story `tests/**/test_*_heldout.py` matches nothing and `git ls-files tests | xargs -n1 basename | sort | uniq -d` is empty; the epic's first acceptance criterion is checked here.

## Scope
In scope: the 78 unpaired `tests/**/test_*_heldout.py` modules (55 under `tests/unit/` including its subpackages, 18 under `tests/interfaces/`, 4 under `tests/scripts/`, 1 under `tests/integration/`), renamed in place. Out of scope: every merged pair (S1-S4), the 10 held-out modules handled by E10a-S1 and E10a-S3, module contents, every file under `src/`, and any test body change.

## Testing
Per file: `pytest --collect-only -q <old path>` before and `pytest --collect-only -q <new path>` after — counts equal (recorded on this ticket as one table of 78 rows). `git ls-files 'tests/**/test_*_heldout.py'` prints nothing; `git ls-files tests | xargs -n1 basename | sort | uniq -d` prints nothing; `make test` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No `tests/**/test_*_heldout.py` file remains (`git ls-files 'tests/**/test_*_heldout.py'` prints nothing).
- [ ] No duplicate basenames under `tests/` (`git ls-files tests | xargs -n1 basename | sort | uniq -d` prints nothing); the three cross-tier files carry their `_store`, `_diffing` and `_reconciler` suffixes.
- [ ] Node counts per file are unchanged across the rename, from the before/after `pytest --collect-only -q` table recorded on this ticket (78 rows).
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` shows `new=0`.
- [ ] `make verify` green.
data.title: Rename the 78 unpaired held-out test modules to drop the _heldout suffix
